sourceClaim: #550 supplies an adaptable four-category, two-round eight-minute warmup example. #130 supports comfortable starting durations; #136 gives extension/flexion/rotation/hips ordering and equal sides. These sources do not supply the complete selection algorithm or a universal ten-minute cooldown.
appDecisions: A pure engine preparationFor function selects patterns by movement registry families, known IDs and complex components. Display names cannot supply programming evidence. No component progression is awarded.

Step-ups and bear squats include squat/ankle preparation; floor/ground routes include gentle floor transitions, pulling includes unloaded row-path rehearsal, full get-ups and overhead components include gentle shoulder preparation. Those substitutions are app choices, not source-authored warmup protocols for every movement.

Optional club preparation uses only a simple club movement already in the written workout, current comparable familiarity, confirmed grip, enabled gear and an owned single club at no more than half the lowest written per-club working load. Otherwise use unloaded preparation. No pair, heavier working club, unowned lighter load or comparison between kg and lb is invented.

Half the written per-club load is a conservative app filter, not a Wildman numerical rule. #550 says below 60% but also gives a contextual ten/fifteen-pound example; no universal ratio is inferred from those informal examples.
Familiarity reuses the existing dated comparison/hold checks, not a new skill setting or certification. Future, changed-method, stale or held work cannot justify the optional loaded warmup.

The existing eight-minute warmup and ten-minute app cooldown stay inside selected workout ceilings. Earlier snapshot allocations are respected. Cooldown times are whole slots including both sides/substitutions; comfortable rest or skipped painful movement is allowed, without strength credit.
Existing UI layout, prescription methods, progression history, V33 keys and backup schema remain. Preparation is computed advice, never a strength receipt.
regression: The exact baseline warmup for Alternating-lead bodyweight step-up omits ankle motion because it searches the display name for squat/lunge. Engine registry-based selection corrects it. The old club template could suggest an unspecified lighter familiar club without checking owned inventory.
limits: Source #550 contextual two-minute transition is not introduced as a hidden universal addition; existing main-work/setup estimates remain unchanged.

Ten-minute cooldown and specific movement substitutions/slots are app allocations. No universal continuous hold, rehabilitation prescription, injury-prevention or physiological outcome guarantee is added.
Technique is not verified by a log, and browser emulation is not physical Android acceptance. All ten gate rows remain unresolved.
